# ZenTao Bug 6363
ZenTao defect 6363: attachment loss on company basic-info detail page when the company record is under admin review for a change; fixed and resolved on 2026-11-09.

## Description
- Module: 开发企业 → 企业基本信息 → 变更审核中 (submitted, awaiting admin approval) detail page.
- Symptom: attachments uploaded at change submission were lost on the detail page.

## Root Cause
- Attachment query used filing-dimension code `BUS_CODE = 040100` + `companyRecordId` instead of change-dimension code `qybgxq` + `changeId`.
- `DeveloperBasicInfoDetail.vue` `displayAppendixBusCode()` only switched between entry-page and filing-dimension codes, missing the change-under-review dimension.

## Fix
- File: `zhi2-web-admin/src/views/company/companyManagement/components/DeveloperBasicInfoDetail.vue`
- Added `displayAppendixAtChangeDimension` reusing `companyRecord.js` `isCompanyRecordChangeUnderAdminReview`.
- `displayAppendixBusCode()` now returns `DEVELOPER_CHANGE_APPENDIX_BUS_CODE` (`qybgxq`) for change-under-review; `displayAppendixBusId()` already switched to `changeId`.
- Commit: submodule `2001247828766ff771bc6eb561adafcbb9ebbc9c` (submodule `develop/v3.0.0` tip), parent gitlink `99f511e`.

## Resolution
- ZenTao write-back via DBX "新禅道" (mysql `192.168.1.87:13306`/zentao, connection `4027e274-2f63-49e6-8a8d-5f25eb1e6c5e`): `UPDATE zt_bug SET status='resolved', resolution='fixed', resolvedBy='tiany', resolvedDate='2026-11-09' WHERE id=6363;`
- Verified: status=resolved, resolution=fixed, resolvedBy=tiany, resolvedDate=2026-11-09.

# Submodule Fix Rebase for Fast-Forward
Rebase a submodule fix branch onto origin/develop/v3.0.0 when it is behind, so the push becomes a fast-forward instead of a rejected non-fast-forward.

## When To Use
- Local develop/v3.0.0 (or submodule equivalent) is stale; origin advanced with merges never pulled locally, so the fix branch is not an ancestor of origin.
- Local develop/v3.0.0 is checked out/locked in the main worktree; merge back via fast-forward refspec pushes (no force) to avoid disturbing parallel WIP.
- Must not force-push to a shared branch.

## Procedure
- Push the submodule first if it is already fast-forward-ready; the submodule SHA is unchanged by the parent rebase.
- Rebase the fix branch onto origin/develop/v3.0.0; a single gitlink commit replays cleanly and the submodule SHA stays the same.
- If the remote advances again mid-work, rebase the submodule onto the new origin tip (gitlink change becomes a trivial ff), point the parent gitlink at the rebased submodule commit, then rebase the parent onto the new origin tip.
- Fix branches can be pushed to origin even when the develop/v3.0.0 merges are rejected.

## Example bug-6363 (2026-11-09)
- Submodule fix `4409af208` based on `6009ddf16`; parent fix branched from local `develop/v3.0.0` at `045d91a`, but origin was ahead at `2892034` (contained the `fix/contract-version-dialog-public-component` merge never pulled).
- Remote later advanced: parent origin `956cdca`, submodule origin `c958bba49`; pushes based on stale local tips were rejected and the parent rebase hit a submodule pointer conflict.
- Fix branches `fix/bug-6363-attachment-lost` (submodule) and `fix/bug-6363-attachment-lost-parent` were created on origin; only the `develop/v3.0.0` merges were rejected.
- Recovery plan: abort the paused parent rebase, rebase submodule onto `c958bba49`, point parent gitlink at the rebased submodule commit, rebase parent onto `956cdca`.

# Flat Submodule Worktree Creation Defect
Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3 repo cannot directly create "flat submodule worktree" in this environment; must use parent worktree + nested submodule structure.

## Description
- Directly `git worktree add` inside submodule repo (zhi2-web-admin) to flat path (e.g., .../V3-wt-xxx) makes git misjudge toplevel as common dir (.git/modules/...), causing git status to show all tracked files deleted.
- Reproduces even with pure ASCII path, unrelated to Chinese path; while nested structure with submodule inside parent worktree works normally.
- 构建配置 `rootDir = resolve(__dirname,"../")` 将产物路径耦合到父仓库，故子模块 worktree 必须落在父仓库根目录内（如 `…\苏州市房地产监测V3\zhi2-web-admin-wt-6358`），`../` 才能解析到父仓库、`dist/` 与 `env/` 才能落点正确
- `node_modules` 仅存在于父仓库根与 `zhi2-web-admin/`，sibling worktree 没有；父仓库根 `node_modules` 的 vite 为 5.4.11，与子模块声明的 8.3.5 不符，故建于父仓库根内的 worktree 仍需将自身 `node_modules` 用 junction 指向 `zhi2-web-admin/node_modules` 以解析正确 vite 8.3.5

## Workflow
- Adopt same nested "parent repo worktree + submodule" as existing bug-6324/6326/6322 worktrees: from parent repo `git worktree add`, then init its inner zhi2-web-admin submodule and switch to target branch.
- Verify worktree normal: `git -C <wt> rev-parse --show-toplevel` should return worktree root, not .git/modules path.

## Relations
- Repos: Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3 (parent) + zhi2-web-admin (submodule)
- Source session: 2026-11-09 session (LpbStatisticsDialog fix task pitfall and verification)

# Flat Submodule Worktree Creation Defect
Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3 repo cannot directly create "flat submodule worktree" in this environment; must use parent worktree + nested submodule structure.

## Description
- Directly `git worktree add` inside submodule repo (zhi2-web-admin) to flat path (e.g., .../V3-wt-xxx) makes git misjudge toplevel as common dir (.git/modules/...), causing git status to show all tracked files deleted.
- Reproduces even with pure ASCII path, unrelated to Chinese path; while nested structure with submodule inside parent worktree works normally.
- 构建配置 `rootDir = resolve(__dirname,"../")` 将产物路径耦合到父仓库，故子模块 worktree 必须落在父仓库根目录内（如 `…\苏州市房地产监测V3\zhi2-web-admin-wt-6358`），`../` 才能解析到父仓库、`dist/` 与 `env/` 才能落点正确
- `node_modules` 仅存在于父仓库根与 `zhi2-web-admin/`，sibling worktree 没有；父仓库根 `node_modules` 的 vite 为 5.4.11，与子模块声明的 8.3.5 不符，故建于父仓库根内的 worktree 仍需将自身 `node_modules` 用 junction 指向 `zhi2-web-admin/node_modules` 以解析正确 vite 8.3.5
- 主 submodule 工作区的 `node_modules/vite` 可能被本机其他会话的 pnpm 操作临时移除（2026-11-09 会话中曾由 8.3.5 变为不存在），junction 连接点本身通常仍可保留；构建脚本建议「重新安装依赖」来自愈

## Workflow
- Adopt same nested "parent repo worktree + submodule" as existing bug-6324/6326/6322 worktrees: from parent repo `git worktree add`, then init its inner zhi2-web-admin submodule and switch to target branch.
- Verify worktree normal: `git -C <wt> rev-parse --show-toplevel` should return worktree root, not .git/modules path.

## Removal Quirk
- `git worktree remove` refuses a worktree that contains a submodule checkout (known guard); even `git submodule deinit` (which clears files) still leaves the gitlink entry so git considers the submodule present.
- Workaround: manually remove the worktree directory, then `git worktree prune` to clear stale metadata; shared submodule module dir and already-pushed commits stay safe.

## Relations
- Repos: Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3 (parent) + zhi2-web-admin (submodule)
- Source session: 2026-11-09 session (LpbStatisticsDialog fix task pitfall and bug-6363 worktree removal)
